guitar.modelsText: Fender Stratocaster "Blackie" / Gibson ES-335 / Martin acoustic
guitar.evidence: Trained knowledge: extremely well documented — "Blackie" Strat, earlier Gibson ES-335/Les Paul/SG (Cream era), Martin acoustics for Unplugged.

tone.target: warm unplugged acoustic-electric strum with room and natural sustain
tone.profile: warm unplugged acoustic-electric strum with room and natural sustain
tone.summary: A clean signal chain using compression and a classic British amp model (UK 50) paired with a room simulation to achieve the required warm, unplugged strumming tone.
corrections: keep it mostly dry and intimate
